LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_FIVE.lessonTitleEnglish: Get on the Internet with a Cell Phone
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_FIVE.learnerPromise: Say how long an action lasts.
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_FIVE.explanation: Put the duration after the verb. If the verb has an object, repeat the verb before the duration, or use V + duration + 的 + object.

lessonWorld.title: Measure the whole journey
lessonWorld.prompt: The group waits ten minutes and visits for three hours.
lessonWorld.traditional: 我們排隊排十分鐘，參觀三個小時。
lessonWorld.simplified: 我们排队排十分钟，参观三个小时。
lessonWorld.pinyin: Wǒmen páiduì pái shí fēnzhōng, cānguān sān ge xiǎoshí.
lessonWorld.english: We wait in line for ten minutes and visit for three hours.

LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_FIVE.pattern: Action + duration / Verb + object + verb + duration

items.question: Where does the duration go?
items.answer: After the verb: 我每天工作八個小時. Do not put it before the verb.

right.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān gōngzuò bā ge xiǎoshí.
right.english: I work eight hours every day.

items.question: What happens when there is an object?
items.answer: Repeat the verb before the duration: 我每天跑步跑三十分鐘.
items.wrongTraditional: 我每天跑步三十分鐘跑。

right.traditional: 我每天跑步跑三十分鐘。
right.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān pǎobù pǎo sānshí fēnzhōng.
right.english: I run thirty minutes every day.
right.simplified: 我每天跑步跑三十分钟。

items.wrongSimplified: 我每天跑步跑三十分钟。

items.question: What does 的 do in 睡七個小時的覺?
items.answer: It joins the duration to the object: seven hours of sleep. Without 的, repeat the verb instead.

right.traditional: 我每天睡七個小時的覺。
right.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān shuì qī ge xiǎoshí de jiào.
right.english: I sleep seven hours every day.
right.simplified: 我每天睡七个小时的觉。

items.wrongSimplified: 我每天睡七个小时的觉。

text.traditional: 爸爸每天早上運動三十分鐘。
text.simplified: 爸爸每天早上运动三十分钟。
text.pinyin: Bàba měitiān zǎoshang yùndòng sānshí fēnzhōng.
text.english: Dad exercises for thirty minutes every morning.

text.traditional: 我們從學校走十分鐘，就可以到那家銀行了。
text.simplified: 我们从学校走十分钟，就可以到那家银行了。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen cóng xuéxiào zǒu shí fēnzhōng, jiù kěyǐ dào nà jiā yínháng le.
text.english: We walk ten minutes from school and can reach that bank.

text.traditional: 不好意思，請您再等兩分鐘，李先生很快就來了。
text.simplified: 不好意思，请您再等两分钟，李先生很快就来了。
text.pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, qǐng nín zài děng liǎng fēnzhōng, Lǐ xiānsheng hěn kuài jiù lái le.
text.english: Sorry, please wait two more minutes; Mr. Li will be here soon.

text.traditional: A：你明天要上課上幾個鐘頭？B：我明天要上課上三個鐘頭。
text.simplified: A：你明天要上课上几个钟头？B：我明天要上课上三个钟头。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ míngtiān yào shàngkè shàng jǐ ge zhōngtóu? B: Wǒ míngtiān yào shàngkè shàng sān ge zhōngtóu.
text.english: A: How many hours of class do you have tomorrow? B: I have three hours of class tomorrow.

text.traditional: A：你每天都運動嗎？B：對，我每天跑步跑三十分鐘。
text.simplified: A：你每天都运动吗？B：对，我每天跑步跑三十分钟。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ měitiān dōu yùndòng ma? B: Duì, wǒ měitiān pǎobù pǎo sānshí fēnzhōng.
text.english: A: Do you exercise every day? B: Yes; I run for thirty minutes every day.

text.traditional: A：你每天做晚飯做兩個小時，不覺得累嗎？B：有時候覺得累，但是我喜歡吃自己做的，所以沒關係。
text.simplified: A：你每天做晚饭做两个小时，不觉得累吗？B：有时候觉得累，但是我喜欢吃自己做的，所以没关系。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ měitiān zuò wǎnfàn zuò liǎng ge xiǎoshí, bù juéde lèi ma? B: Yǒu shíhou juéde lèi, dànshì wǒ xǐhuān chī zìjǐ zuò de, suǒyǐ méi guānxi.
text.english: A: You cook dinner for two hours every day; don’t you feel tired? B: Sometimes I feel tired, but I like eating what I make myself, so it’s okay.

text.traditional: A：我明天要開六個小時的車，我想先去睡覺。B：開六個小時的車一定會很累，你去睡吧。
text.simplified: A：我明天要开六个小时的车，我想先去睡觉。B：开六个小时的车一定会很累，你去睡吧。
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ míngtiān yào kāi liù ge xiǎoshí de chē, wǒ xiǎng xiān qù shuìjiào. B: Kāi liù ge xiǎoshí de chē yídìng huì hěn lèi, nǐ qù shuì ba.
text.english: A: I have to drive for six hours tomorrow; I want to sleep first. B: Driving for six hours will surely be tiring; go to sleep.

text.traditional: A：我弟弟很愛玩手機，每天差不多玩五個小時。B：玩五個小時的手機！時間太長了！
text.simplified: A：我弟弟很爱玩手机，每天差不多玩五个小时。B：玩五个小时的手机！时间太长了！
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ dìdi hěn ài wán shǒujī, měitiān chàbuduō wán wǔ ge xiǎoshí. B: Wán wǔ ge xiǎoshí de shǒujī! Shíjiān tài cháng le!
text.english: A: My younger brother loves playing with his phone; he plays about five hours every day. B: Five hours of phone time! That is too long!

words.meaning: links the duration to 手機

text.traditional: A：聽說那個博物館不太遠，只要坐五分鐘的捷運。B：是啊，如果你想走路去也可以，走二十分鐘的路就到了。
text.simplified: A：听说那个博物馆不太远，只要坐五分钟的捷运。B：是啊，如果你想走路去也可以，走二十分钟的路就到了。
text.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō nàge bówùguǎn bú tài yuǎn, zhǐyào zuò wǔ fēnzhōng de jiéyùn. B: Shì a, rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng zǒulù qù yě kěyǐ, zǒu èrshí fēnzhōng de lù jiù dào le.
text.english: A: I heard that museum is not far; it is only a five-minute MRT ride. B: Right; if you want to walk, you can walk there in twenty minutes.

words.meaning: links the duration to 捷運

questions.correctFeedback: Duration + 的 appears before 中文.

subsections.title: Verbs without objects
subsections.explanation: Put the duration after the verb.

patternRows.english: I work for eight hours every day.

subsections.title: Verbs with objects: repeat the verb
subsections.explanation: If there is an object, repeat the verb before the duration: 睡覺睡七個小時.

patternRows.english: I sleep for seven hours every day.

subsections.title: Verbs with objects: duration + 的
subsections.explanation: You can also put the duration before 的 and the object: 睡七個小時的覺.

columns.meaning: links the duration to the object

LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_FOUR.lessonTitleEnglish: Get on the Internet with a Cell Phone
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_FOUR.titleEnglish: Start a Countdown with 就要…了
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_FOUR.learnerPromise: Say that something is about to happen.
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_FOUR.explanation: Put 就要 before the event and 了 at the end. A time word usually comes before 就要: 我下個月就要回國了.

lessonWorld.title: Get to the museum before it opens
lessonWorld.prompt: It is 8:55. The museum opens at nine.
lessonWorld.traditional: 博物館五分鐘以後就要開門了。
lessonWorld.simplified: 博物馆五分钟以后就要开门了。
lessonWorld.pinyin: Bówùguǎn wǔ fēnzhōng yǐhòu jiù yào kāimén le.
lessonWorld.english: The museum will open in five minutes.

LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_FOUR.pattern: Subject + Time + 就要 + Event + 了

patternRows.english: I am going back to my country next month.

items.question: Does 就要…了 need the final 了?
items.answer: The book’s pattern closes with 了: 他明天就要來了. Without 了 the sentence sounds unfinished in this context.

right.pinyin: Tā míngtiān jiù yào lái le.
right.english: He is coming tomorrow.

items.question: Where does 就要 go?
items.answer: Before the event: 圖書館就要關了. A time word goes before 就要.

right.pinyin: Túshūguǎn jiù yào guān le.
right.english: The library is about to close.

items.question: Is 快要 also correct?
items.answer: Yes. 快要…了 is another common form. The book uses 就要 in this table; both mean “about to”.

right.pinyin: Tā míngtiān jiù yào lái le.
right.english: He is coming tomorrow.

text.traditional: 他的女朋友明天就要來了，他非常開心。
text.simplified: 他的女朋友明天就要来了，他非常开心。
text.pinyin: Tā de nǚpéngyǒu míngtiān jiù yào lái le, tā fēicháng kāixīn.
text.english: His girlfriend is coming tomorrow; he is very happy.

text.traditional: 電影馬上就開始了，他怎麼還沒來？
text.simplified: 电影马上就开始了，他怎么还没来？
text.pinyin: Diànyǐng mǎshàng jiù kāishǐ le, tā zěnme háiméi lái?
text.english: The movie is about to start; why has he not come yet?

text.traditional: 圖書館就要關了，你現在去也許太晚了。
text.simplified: 图书馆就要关了，你现在去也许太晚了。
text.pinyin: Túshūguǎn jiù yào guān le, nǐ xiànzài qù yěxǔ tài wǎn le.
text.english: The library is about to close; going now might be too late.

LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_FOUR.exerciseInstruction: Use the printed cue to build the imminent event.

questions.correctFeedback: The countdown signal comes before the event.
馬上 and 就要 both point forward to 開始.
快要 comes before the approaching arrival.

LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_ONE.lessonTitleEnglish: Get on the Internet with a Cell Phone
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_ONE.learnerPromise: Make an action sound short and easy.
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_ONE.explanation: Repeat the verb to soften the action: 看看 or 看一看. The 一 is optional and adds a light “have a look” feel.

lessonWorld.title: Get to the museum before it opens
lessonWorld.prompt: Guoan sends the museum website. Zhongming takes a quick look.
lessonWorld.english: You can take a quick look first.

columns.traditional: 我今天不想出去，只想在家
columns.pinyin: wǒ jīntiān bù xiǎng chūqù, zhǐ xiǎng zài jiā
columns.meaning: I don’t want to go out today; I just want to stay home

patternRows.english: I don’t want to go out today. I just want to listen to music at home.

columns.traditional: 聽說他的新房子很漂亮，我想去
columns.pinyin: tīngshuō tā de xīn fángzi hěn piàoliang, wǒ xiǎng qù
columns.meaning: I heard his new house is pretty; I want to go

patternRows.english: I’ve heard that his new house is very pretty. I want to have a look.

items.question: Is 一 required in 看看 / 看一看?
items.answer: No. Both are correct. 一 adds a light “have a look” feel; the repeated verb is the main signal.

right.pinyin: Wǒ kàn yī kàn.
right.english: I take a look.

items.question: Can I add 了 after a reduplicated verb?
items.answer: No. The reduplication already softens the action; 了 does not follow it: 我看看, not 我看看了.

right.pinyin: Wǒ kàn kàn.
right.english: I take a look.

text.traditional: 他週末常去打打球、看看電影。
text.simplified: 他周末常去打打球、看看电影。
text.pinyin: Tā zhōumò cháng qù dǎ dǎ qiú, kàn kàn diànyǐng.
text.english: On weekends he often plays ball and watches movies.

text.traditional: 我平常有空的時候，都在家上上網、玩玩手機。
text.simplified: 我平常有空的时候，都在家上上网、玩玩手机。
text.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng yǒu kòng de shíhou, dōu zài jiā shàng shàng wǎng, wán wán shǒujī.
text.english: When I have free time, I stay home, go online, and play with my phone.

words.meaning: links the description to 時候

text.traditional: 媽媽最近心情不太好，我們應該多跟她說說話。
text.simplified: 妈妈最近心情不太好，我们应该多跟她说说话。
text.pinyin: Māma zuìjìn xīnqíng bú tài hǎo, wǒmen yīnggāi duō gēn tā shuō shuō huà.
text.english: Mom has not been in a good mood lately; we should talk with her more.

text.traditional: 上班的休息時間，我常跟同事一起喝喝咖啡、聊聊天。
text.simplified: 上班的休息时间，我常跟同事一起喝喝咖啡、聊聊天。
text.pinyin: Shàngbān de xiūxi shíjiān, wǒ cháng gēn tóngshì yìqǐ hē hē kāfēi, liáo liáo tiān.
text.english: During work breaks, I often drink coffee and chat with colleagues.

words.meaning: links the description to 時間

LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_THREE.lessonTitleEnglish: Get on the Internet with a Cell Phone
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_THREE.titleEnglish: Read the Time and Result Meanings of 就
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_THREE.learnerPromise: Say that something happens earlier than expected, or comes easily.
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_THREE.explanation: 就 can say something happens earlier than expected: 九點開始上班，可是我每天都八點半就到公司了. It can also introduce an easy result: 你往前走，就可以看到那家店了.

lessonWorld.title: Get to the museum before it opens
lessonWorld.prompt: The route is short: walk five minutes and you arrive.
lessonWorld.pinyin: Wǎng yòu zǒu, wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
lessonWorld.english: Walk right and you will arrive in five minutes.

LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_THREE.pattern: Time + 就 + action / Instruction，就 + result

items.question: Where does 就 go?
items.answer: After the time word and before the verb: 我六點就起床了. Do not put it after the verb.

right.pinyin: Wǒ liù diǎn jiù qǐchuáng le.
right.english: I got up at six.

items.question: Does 就 link the instruction to the result?
items.answer: Use one result word: 你往前走，就可以看到那家店了.
items.wrongTraditional: 你往前走，就才可以看到那家店了。

right.traditional: 你往前走，就可以看到那家店了。
right.pinyin: Nǐ wǎng qián zǒu, jiù kěyǐ kàndào nà jiā diàn le.
right.english: Walk forward and you can see that shop.
right.simplified: 你往前走，就可以看到那家店了。

items.wrongSimplified: 你往前走，就才可以看到那家店了。

items.question: What does 就 add in 八點半就到?
items.answer: It says the time is earlier than expected. Without 就, the sentence just reports the time.
items.wrongTraditional: 我每天都八點半到公司了。

right.traditional: 我每天都八點半就到公司了。
right.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān dōu bā diǎn bàn jiù dào gōngsī le.
right.english: I arrive at the company at eight thirty every day (earlier than expected).
right.simplified: 我每天都八点半就到公司了。

items.wrongSimplified: 我每天都八点半就到公司了。

text.traditional: 我今天早上六點就起床了。
text.simplified: 我今天早上六点就起床了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān zǎoshang liù diǎn jiù qǐchuáng le.
text.english: I got up at six this morning.

text.traditional: 你往前走，就可以看到那家店了。
text.simplified: 你往前走，就可以看到那家店了。
text.pinyin: Nǐ wǎng qián zǒu, jiù kěyǐ kàndào nà jiā diàn le.
text.english: Walk forward and you can see that shop.

text.traditional: 你先跟老師請假，就沒問題了吧？
text.simplified: 你先跟老师请假，就没问题了吧？
text.pinyin: Nǐ xiān gēn lǎoshī qǐngjià, jiù méi wèntí le ba?
text.english: First ask the teacher for leave, and there will be no problem.

questions.correctFeedback: 就 introduces the result of checking.
questions.repairFeedback: Place 就 before the result action.

LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_TWO.lessonTitleEnglish: Get on the Internet with a Cell Phone
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_TWO.titleEnglish: Move from a Start toward a Direction
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_TWO.learnerPromise: Say where a movement starts and which way it goes.
LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_TWO.explanation: Use 從 before the starting point and 往 before the direction or endpoint: 從左往右寫.

lessonWorld.title: Get to the museum before it opens
lessonWorld.prompt: The museum is near Guoan’s home.
lessonWorld.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā chūqù, wǎng yòu zhuǎn.
lessonWorld.english: Go out from my home and turn right.

LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_TWO.pattern: 從 + start + 往 + direction + action

patternRows.english: to write from the left to the right
to look from here to the doorway

items.question: Where does 往 go?
items.answer: Before the direction: 從左往右寫. Do not put 往 after the verb.

right.pinyin: Cóng zuǒ wǎng yòu xiě.
right.english: Write from left to right.

items.question: Which comes first, 從 or 往?
items.answer: 從 marks the start and comes first: 從這裡往門口看. 往 marks the direction.

right.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ wǎng ménkǒu kàn.
right.english: Look from here toward the doorway.

items.question: Can I use 到 instead of 往?
items.answer: 到 marks an endpoint, so 從左到右寫 is also correct. The book pattern uses 往 for the direction: 從左往右寫.

right.pinyin: Cóng zuǒ wǎng yòu xiě.
right.english: Write from left to right.

text.traditional: 中國字應該從左往右寫，韓國字呢？
text.simplified: 中国字应该从左往右写，韩国字呢？
text.pinyin: Zhōngguó zì yīnggāi cóng zuǒ wǎng yòu xiě, Hánguó zì ne?
text.english: Chinese characters should be written from left to right; what about Korean characters?

text.traditional: 從我房間的窗戶往外看，就可以看到漂亮的風景。
text.simplified: 从我房间的窗户往外看，就可以看到漂亮的风景。
text.pinyin: Cóng wǒ fángjiān de chuānghu wǎng wài kàn, jiù kěyǐ kàndào piàoliang de fēngjǐng.
text.english: Looking out from my room’s window, you can see a beautiful view.

words.meaning: links the description to 風景

text.traditional: 從這裡往最高的那棟房子走，你會看到兩家百貨公司。
text.simplified: 从这里往最高的那栋房子走，你会看到两家百货公司。
text.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ wǎng zuì gāo de nà dòng fángzi zǒu, nǐ huì kàndào liǎng jiā bǎihuò gōngsī.
text.english: Walk from here toward the tallest building, and you will see two department stores.

words.meaning: links the description to 房子

LESSON_THIRTEEN_GRAMMAR_TWO.exerciseInstruction: Use the picture to choose the start and the direction.

segments.hint: Use 從 + start + 往 + direction.

tiles.meaning: walk from here toward the entrance

questions.correctFeedback: 這裡 is the start; 門口 is the direction.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 從 + start + 往 + direction.

items.question: Is 一 required in 看看 / 看一看?

items.question: Can I add 了 after a reduplicated verb?
items.answer: No. The reduplication already softens the action; 了 does not follow it: 我看看, not 我看看了.

grammarPages.explanation: 就 can say something happens earlier than expected: 九點開始上班，可是我每天都八點半就到公司了. It can also introduce an easy result: 你往前走，就可以看到那家店了.

grammarPages.pattern: Time + 就 + action / Instruction，就 + result

items.question: Where does 就 go?
items.answer: After the time word and before the verb: 我六點就起床了. Do not put it after the verb.

right.pinyin: Wǒ liù diǎn jiù qǐchuáng le.
right.english: I got up at six.

items.question: Does 就 link the instruction to the result?
items.answer: Use one result word: 你往前走，就可以看到那家店了.
items.wrongTraditional: 你往前走，就才可以看到那家店了。

right.traditional: 你往前走，就可以看到那家店了。
right.pinyin: Nǐ wǎng qián zǒu, jiù kěyǐ kàndào nà jiā diàn le.
right.english: Walk forward and you can see that shop.
right.simplified: 你往前走，就可以看到那家店了。

items.wrongSimplified: 你往前走，就才可以看到那家店了。

items.question: What does 就 add in 八點半就到?
items.answer: It says the time is earlier than expected. Without 就, the sentence just reports the time.
items.wrongTraditional: 我每天都八點半到公司了。

right.traditional: 我每天都八點半就到公司了。
right.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān dōu bā diǎn bàn jiù dào gōngsī le.
right.english: I arrive at the company at eight thirty every day (earlier than expected).
right.simplified: 我每天都八点半就到公司了。

items.wrongSimplified: 我每天都八点半就到公司了。

text.english: I got up at six this morning.

text.pinyin: Nǐ wǎng qián zǒu, jiù kěyǐ kàndào nà jiā diàn le.
text.english: Walk forward and you can see that shop.

dialogue.title: 對話一 · Dialogue 1
dialogue.setting: 國安給中明打電話 · Guoan calls Zhongming

text.traditional: 喂，中明，半個小時以前我寄了一封電子郵件給你，你看到了嗎？
text.simplified: 喂，中明，半个小时以前我寄了一封电子邮件给你，你看到了吗？
text.pinyin: Wèi, Zhōngmíng, bàn ge xiǎoshí yǐqián wǒ jì le yì fēng diànzǐ yóujiàn gěi nǐ, nǐ kàndào le ma?
text.english: Hello, Zhongming, I sent you an email half an hour ago. Have you read it?

text.traditional: 剛剛我的手機網路有點兒問題，不能看電子郵件，你寄的是什麼？
text.simplified: 刚刚我的手机网路有点儿问题，不能看电子邮件，你寄的是什么？
text.pinyin: Gānggāng wǒ de shǒujī wǎnglù yǒudiǎnr wèntí, bù néng kàn diànzǐ yóujiàn, nǐ jì de shì shénme?
text.english: The internet connection on my phone just had a little problem; I couldn’t read your email. What did you send me?

text.traditional: 博物館的網址。下禮拜六老師要帶我們去參觀，你可以先看看。
text.simplified: 博物馆的网址。下礼拜六老师要带我们去参观，你可以先看看。
text.pinyin: Bówùguǎn de wǎngzhǐ. Xià lǐbàiliù lǎoshī yào dài wǒmen qù cānguān, nǐ kěyǐ xiān kànkan.
text.english: I sent you a link for the museum website. The teacher is taking us to visit there next Saturday; you can take a look first.

text.traditional: 好。（看看手機）現在沒問題了，我看到了。
text.simplified: 好。（看看手机）现在没问题了，我看到了。
text.pinyin: Hǎo. (Kànkan shǒujī) Xiànzài méi wèntí le, wǒ kàndào le.
text.english: OK. (Take a look at the phone) There’s no problem now, I’ve read your email.

text.traditional: 網站上有地址，那個地方在我家附近，從我家出去，往右轉，差不多五分鐘就到了。
text.simplified: 网站上有地址，那个地方在我家附近，从我家出去，往右转，差不多五分钟就到了。
text.pinyin: Wǎngzhàn shang yǒu dìzhǐ, nà ge dìfang zài wǒ jiā fùjìn, cóng wǒ jiā chūqù, wǎng yòu zhuǎn, chàbuduō wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
text.english: There’s the address on the website; that place is close to my house. If you go from my place, you make a right turn, and you’ll be there in just about five minutes.

text.traditional: 我們應該幾點到？
text.simplified: 我们应该几点到？
text.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi jǐ diǎn dào?
text.english: What time should we be there?

text.traditional: 早上九點在博物館門口見，要記得準時到。
text.simplified: 早上九点在博物馆门口见，要记得准时到。
text.pinyin: Zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn zài bówùguǎn ménkǒu jiàn, yào jìde zhǔnshí dào.
text.english: 9 a.m. at the museum gate. Remember to get there on time.

text.traditional: 我們上個星期六去運動的時候，我到得太晚，真不好意思。下個星期我一定會準時。
text.simplified: 我们上个星期六去运动的时候，我到得太晚，真不好意思。下个星期我一定会准时。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen shàng ge xīngqīliù qù yùndòng de shíhòu, wǒ dào de tài wǎn, zhēn bù hǎoyìsi. Xià ge xīngqī wǒ yídìng huì zhǔnshí.
text.english: I am sorry for being late when we went exercising last Saturday. I’ll definitely be on time next week.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Start a Countdown with 就要…了
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that something is about to happen.
grammarPages.explanation: Put 就要 before the event and 了 at the end. A time word usually comes before 就要: 我下個月就要回國了.

lessonWorld.title: Get to the museum before it opens
lessonWorld.prompt: It is 8:55. The museum opens at nine.
lessonWorld.traditional: 博物館五分鐘以後就要開門了。
lessonWorld.simplified: 博物馆五分钟以后就要开门了。
lessonWorld.pinyin: Bówùguǎn wǔ fēnzhōng yǐhòu jiù yào kāimén le.
lessonWorld.english: The museum will open in five minutes.

grammarPages.pattern: Subject + Time + 就要 + Event + 了

patternRows.english: I am going back to my country next month.

items.question: Does 就要…了 need the final 了?
items.answer: The book’s pattern closes with 了: 他明天就要來了. Without 了 the sentence sounds unfinished in this context.

right.pinyin: Tā míngtiān jiù yào lái le.
right.english: He is coming tomorrow.

items.question: Where does 就要 go?
items.answer: Before the event: 圖書館就要關了. A time word goes before 就要.

right.pinyin: Túshūguǎn jiù yào guān le.
right.english: The library is about to close.

items.question: Is 快要 also correct?
items.answer: Yes. 快要…了 is another common form. The book uses 就要 in this table; both mean “about to”.

right.pinyin: Tā míngtiān jiù yào lái le.
right.english: He is coming tomorrow.

text.traditional: 他的女朋友明天就要來了，他非常開心。
text.simplified: 他的女朋友明天就要来了，他非常开心。
text.pinyin: Tā de nǚpéngyǒu míngtiān jiù yào lái le, tā fēicháng kāixīn.
text.english: His girlfriend is coming tomorrow; he is very happy.

text.traditional: 電影馬上就開始了，他怎麼還沒來？
text.simplified: 电影马上就开始了，他怎么还没来？
text.pinyin: Diànyǐng mǎshàng jiù kāishǐ le, tā zěnme háiméi lái?
text.english: The movie is about to start; why has he not come yet?

text.traditional: 圖書館就要關了，你現在去也許太晚了。
text.simplified: 图书馆就要关了，你现在去也许太晚了。
text.pinyin: Túshūguǎn jiù yào guān le, nǐ xiànzài qù yěxǔ tài wǎn le.
text.english: The library is about to close; going now might be too late.

questions.correctFeedback: The countdown signal comes before the event.
馬上 and 就要 both point forward to 開始.
快要 comes before the approaching arrival.

grammarPages.explanation: Put the duration after the verb. If the verb has an object, repeat the verb before the duration, or use V + duration + 的 + object.

lessonWorld.title: Measure the whole journey
lessonWorld.prompt: The group waits ten minutes and visits for three hours.
lessonWorld.traditional: 我們排隊排十分鐘，參觀三個小時。
lessonWorld.simplified: 我们排队排十分钟，参观三个小时。
lessonWorld.pinyin: Wǒmen páiduì pái shí fēnzhōng, cānguān sān ge xiǎoshí.
lessonWorld.english: We wait in line for ten minutes and visit for three hours.

grammarPages.pattern: Action + duration / Verb + object + verb + duration

items.question: Where does the duration go?
items.answer: After the verb: 我每天工作八個小時. Do not put it before the verb.

right.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān gōngzuò bā ge xiǎoshí.
right.english: I work eight hours every day.

items.question: What happens when there is an object?
items.answer: Repeat the verb before the duration: 我每天跑步跑三十分鐘.
items.wrongTraditional: 我每天跑步三十分鐘跑。

right.traditional: 我每天跑步跑三十分鐘。
right.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān pǎobù pǎo sānshí fēnzhōng.
right.english: I run thirty minutes every day.
right.simplified: 我每天跑步跑三十分钟。

items.wrongSimplified: 我每天跑步跑三十分钟。

items.question: What does 的 do in 睡七個小時的覺?
items.answer: It joins the duration to the object: seven hours of sleep. Without 的, repeat the verb instead.

right.traditional: 我每天睡七個小時的覺。
right.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān shuì qī ge xiǎoshí de jiào.
right.english: I sleep seven hours every day.
right.simplified: 我每天睡七个小时的觉。

items.wrongSimplified: 我每天睡七个小时的觉。

text.traditional: 爸爸每天早上運動三十分鐘。
text.simplified: 爸爸每天早上运动三十分钟。
text.pinyin: Bàba měitiān zǎoshang yùndòng sānshí fēnzhōng.
text.english: Dad exercises for thirty minutes every morning.

text.traditional: 我們從學校走十分鐘，就可以到那家銀行了。
text.simplified: 我们从学校走十分钟，就可以到那家银行了。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen cóng xuéxiào zǒu shí fēnzhōng, jiù kěyǐ dào nà jiā yínháng le.
text.english: We walk ten minutes from school and can reach that bank.

text.traditional: 不好意思，請您再等兩分鐘，李先生很快就來了。
text.simplified: 不好意思，请您再等两分钟，李先生很快就来了。
text.pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, qǐng nín zài děng liǎng fēnzhōng, Lǐ xiānsheng hěn kuài jiù lái le.
text.english: Sorry, please wait two more minutes; Mr. Li will be here soon.

text.traditional: A：你明天要上課上幾個鐘頭？B：我明天要上課上三個鐘頭。
text.simplified: A：你明天要上课上几个钟头？B：我明天要上课上三个钟头。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ míngtiān yào shàngkè shàng jǐ ge zhōngtóu? B: Wǒ míngtiān yào shàngkè shàng sān ge zhōngtóu.
text.english: A: How many hours of class do you have tomorrow? B: I have three hours of class tomorrow.

text.traditional: A：你每天都運動嗎？B：對，我每天跑步跑三十分鐘。
text.simplified: A：你每天都运动吗？B：对，我每天跑步跑三十分钟。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ měitiān dōu yùndòng ma? B: Duì, wǒ měitiān pǎobù pǎo sānshí fēnzhōng.
text.english: A: Do you exercise every day? B: Yes; I run for thirty minutes every day.

text.traditional: A：你每天做晚飯做兩個小時，不覺得累嗎？B：有時候覺得累，但是我喜歡吃自己做的，所以沒關係。
text.simplified: A：你每天做晚饭做两个小时，不觉得累吗？B：有时候觉得累，但是我喜欢吃自己做的，所以没关系。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ měitiān zuò wǎnfàn zuò liǎng ge xiǎoshí, bù juéde lèi ma? B: Yǒu shíhou juéde lèi, dànshì wǒ xǐhuān chī zìjǐ zuò de, suǒyǐ méi guānxi.
text.english: A: You cook dinner for two hours every day; don’t you feel tired? B: Sometimes I feel tired, but I like eating what I make myself, so it’s okay.

text.traditional: A：我明天要開六個小時的車，我想先去睡覺。B：開六個小時的車一定會很累，你去睡吧。
text.simplified: A：我明天要开六个小时的车，我想先去睡觉。B：开六个小时的车一定会很累，你去睡吧。
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ míngtiān yào kāi liù ge xiǎoshí de chē, wǒ xiǎng xiān qù shuìjiào. B: Kāi liù ge xiǎoshí de chē yídìng huì hěn lèi, nǐ qù shuì ba.
text.english: A: I have to drive for six hours tomorrow; I want to sleep first. B: Driving for six hours will surely be tiring; go to sleep.

text.traditional: A：我弟弟很愛玩手機，每天差不多玩五個小時。B：玩五個小時的手機！時間太長了！
text.simplified: A：我弟弟很爱玩手机，每天差不多玩五个小时。B：玩五个小时的手机！时间太长了！
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ dìdi hěn ài wán shǒujī, měitiān chàbuduō wán wǔ ge xiǎoshí. B: Wán wǔ ge xiǎoshí de shǒujī! Shíjiān tài cháng le!
text.english: A: My younger brother loves playing with his phone; he plays about five hours every day. B: Five hours of phone time! That is too long!

words.meaning: links the duration to 手機

text.traditional: A：聽說那個博物館不太遠，只要坐五分鐘的捷運。B：是啊，如果你想走路去也可以，走二十分鐘的路就到了。
text.simplified: A：听说那个博物馆不太远，只要坐五分钟的捷运。B：是啊，如果你想走路去也可以，走二十分钟的路就到了。
text.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō nàge bówùguǎn bú tài yuǎn, zhǐyào zuò wǔ fēnzhōng de jiéyùn. B: Shì a, rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng zǒulù qù yě kěyǐ, zǒu èrshí fēnzhōng de lù jiù dào le.
text.english: A: I heard that museum is not far; it is only a five-minute MRT ride. B: Right; if you want to walk, you can walk there in twenty minutes.

words.meaning: links the duration to 捷運

subsections.title: Verbs without objects
subsections.explanation: Put the duration after the verb.

patternRows.english: I work for eight hours every day.

subsections.title: Verbs with objects: repeat the verb
subsections.explanation: If there is an object, repeat the verb before the duration: 睡覺睡七個小時.

patternRows.english: I sleep for seven hours every day.

subsections.title: Verbs with objects: duration + 的
subsections.explanation: You can also put the duration before 的 and the object: 睡七個小時的覺.

columns.meaning: links the duration to the object

patternRows.english: I sleep for seven hours every day.

dialogue.title: 對話二 · Dialogue 2
dialogue.setting: 在博物館門口 · At the museum gate

text.traditional: 博物館五分鐘以後就要開門了，大家都到了吧？
text.simplified: 博物馆五分钟以后就要开门了，大家都到了吧？
text.pinyin: Bówùguǎn wǔ fēnzhōng yǐhòu jiù yào kāimén le, dàjiā dōu dào le ba?
text.english: The museum will be open after five minutes. Is everyone here already?

text.traditional: 中明說他快要到了。
text.simplified: 中明说他快要到了。
text.pinyin: Zhōngmíng shuō tā kuài yào dào le.
text.english: Zhongming said he’ll be here soon.

text.traditional: 老師，我們要不要先去排隊買票？
text.simplified: 老师，我们要不要先去排队买票？
text.pinyin: Lǎoshī, wǒmen yào bu yào xiān qù páiduì mǎi piào?
text.english: Teacher, should we get in line to buy tickets first?

text.traditional: 差不多需要排十分鐘的隊，那好吧，我們先去排隊。
text.simplified: 差不多需要排十分钟的队，那好吧，我们先去排队。
text.pinyin: Chàbuduō xūyào pái shí fēnzhōng de duì, nà hǎo ba, wǒmen xiān qù páiduì.
text.english: It takes about ten minutes to line up. Alright, let’s get in line to buy tickets first.

text.traditional: 今天我們打算參觀三個小時，會有人給我們介紹。進去以後，記得要安靜，不可以說話說得太大聲。
text.simplified: 今天我们打算参观三个小时，会有人给我们介绍。进去以后，记得要安静，不可以说话说得太大声。
text.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒmen dǎsuàn cānguān sān ge xiǎoshí, huì yǒu rén gěi wǒmen jièshào. Jìnqù yǐhòu, jìde yào ānjìng, bù kěyǐ shuōhuà shuō de tài dàshēng.
text.english: We plan to visit for three hours today. There will be someone introducing the museum for us. After you enter, remember to keep quiet. You can’t speak loudly.

text.traditional: 老師，我剛剛先用手機上網看了很多有趣的圖片，真想馬上就看到博物館裡的東西。
text.simplified: 老师，我刚刚先用手机上网看了很多有趣的图片，真想马上就看到博物馆里的东西。
text.pinyin: Lǎoshī, wǒ gānggāng xiān yòng shǒujī shàngwǎng kàn le hěn duō yǒuqù de túpiàn, zhēn xiǎng mǎshàng jiù kàndào bówùguǎn lǐ de dōngxi.
text.english: Teacher, I just used my cell phone to look for some information on the internet, and I saw many interesting pictures. I want to see what they have in the museum right away.

text.traditional: 我知道你非常喜歡歷史，我想你今天一定會很開心。
text.simplified: 我知道你非常喜欢历史，我想你今天一定会很开心。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào nǐ fēicháng xǐhuān lìshǐ, wǒ xiǎng nǐ jīntiān yídìng huì hěn kāixīn.
text.english: I know you like history very much. I think you’ll enjoy it a lot today.

text.traditional: 我也在網路上找了很多文章，那些介紹和故事都非常有趣。
text.simplified: 我也在网路上找了很多文章，那些介绍和故事都非常有趣。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yě zài wǎnglù shang zhǎo le hěn duō wénzhāng, nàxiē jièshào hé gùshi dōu fēicháng yǒuqù.
text.english: I also found many articles on the internet. Those introductions and stories are very fascinating.

text.traditional: 那如果大家有問題就可以問你了。
text.simplified: 那如果大家有问题就可以问你了。
text.pinyin: Nà rúguǒ dàjiā yǒu wèntí jiù kěyǐ wèn nǐ le.
text.english: If anyone has questions, they can ask you then.

text.traditional: 要是我知道，一定會告訴大家！
text.simplified: 要是我知道，一定会告诉大家！
text.pinyin: Yàoshi wǒ zhīdào, yídìng huì gàosu dàjiā!
text.english: If I know the answers, I’ll tell them for sure!

text.traditional: （往前看）中明來了！
text.simplified: （往前看）中明来了！
text.pinyin: (Wǎng qián kàn) Zhōngmíng lái le!
text.english: (Look forward) Here comes Zhongming!

text.traditional: 好，我們進去參觀吧。
text.simplified: 好，我们进去参观吧。
text.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒmen jìnqù cānguān ba.
text.english: Okay! Let’s get in to visit.
